text:
maya: Heads up — SI handoff play for Marketplace + EdgeGrid (HW) needs final rules. Quick sync?
omar: Dropping a proposal below, super short.
maya: TL;DR: we need deterministic owner, a nurture window, marketplace tagging rules, and a conflict tie-breaker.
kevin: Agreed. For Global SIs we must also map lead source -> ownership and decide ARR thresholds.
tara: Quick question — who books POC / demo when SI claims? Field or SI?
lucy: Legal note: partner-sourced leads need consent flag & MSA acceptance before SI can sign contracts or run paid POCs.
omar: Proposed mapping (pseudo):
```
# mapping rules
if lead.source == "partner" and lead.partner == "EdgeGrid":
  owner = "SI"
elif lead.ARR >= 100000:
  owner = "Field"
elif lead.region == "APAC" and partner.has_local_sales:
  owner = "SI"
else:
  owner = "rotating_queue"  # default revenue line
```
maya: Proposed workflow: SI has a 14-day claim window to convert or provide evidence (intro email, SOW, signed NDA). If nothing, auto-release back to field/ORS.
tara: :thumbsup: 14 days sounds fair. For demos, if SI claims they should schedule but mark as "SI-intro" and book with Field on standby.
kevin: Marketplace nuance: trials initiated via marketplace are treated as partner leads only if partner_ref tag present (eg_ref). We'll need Marketplace instrumentation.
omar: Instrumentation additions: add tags `si_claimed_ts`, `claim_evidence`, and `partner_ref`. Also emit webhook event `si_claimed` for ops.
maya: Can we automate the release? Nightly sweep that checks `si_claimed_ts + 14d` and moves ownership if no evidence.
deploy-bot: scheduled job "si-handoff-sweeper" created. Runs nightly 02:00 UTC.
lucy: Also add clause in SI agreement: "EdgeGrid must confirm customer consent and acceptance of Redwood MSA prior to commercial outreach."
kevin: Conflict cases: if both Field and SI claim — tie-breaker rules: 1) customer opt-in (explicit) wins, 2) ARR > 500k -> Field wins, 3) partner-provided signed docs -> SI wins, 4) otherwise Sales Ops adjudicates within 48h.
maya: I like that. I'll draft the playbook doc and a short JSON spec for engineering to implement mapping and webhooks. Assign owners: tara -> playbook owner (field side), kevin -> partner ops, omar -> instrumentation/spec, lucy -> contract language, maya -> PM/coord.
tara: I'll start the playbook template tomorrow morning and tag legal snippets.
omar: Will prototype webhook payload by EOD Fri. Sample payload: 
```
{
  "lead_id": "L-12345",
  "event": "si_claimed",
  "claimed_by": "EdgeGrid",
  "claimed_ts": "2025-10-18T02:12:00Z",
  "tags": ["eg_ref", "marketplace_trial"]
}
```
maya: Thanks all — once the doc + spec exist we can run a 1hr ops walkthrough next week. Ping me any blockers.
kevin: I'll coordinate with EdgeGrid on consent flow.
lucy: I'll draft the MSA paragraph and share in thread.
tara: 👍 will capture booking rules and demo checklist.
maya: Closing — I'll post the first draft in #partnerships-docs and @here the walkthrough invite. Thanks!
